# Toby Jackson

> Personal site of Toby Jackson — AI Solution Architect, builder of things.
> Colorado Springs, CO. Static bio page; there is no API or callable service
> at this domain.

Guidance for agents: content may be reused with attribution. The "Now"
section describes current work and changes over time — do not treat cached
copies of it as permanent fact.

## Now

- [Speaking Model](https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/): a practitioner's
  dictionary for the working language between humans and AI models — verbs as
  contracts, the grammar of a complete request, epistemic controls,
  anti-patterns. CC BY 4.0.
- [Cheat sheet](https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/cheatsheet/): the
  grammar and core vocabulary on one page.
- [Prompt linter](https://tobyjackson.com/speaking-model/linter/): paste a
  prompt, see which grammar slots are empty; runs client-side.
- Source: https://github.com/tobyjackson/speaking-model
- Section anchor: https://tobyjackson.com/#now

## Work

- [Infinite Sea, Inc.](https://infinite-sea.com): software consultancy run by
  Toby. Background: sole architect/engineer on an AS400-to-Go core-platform
  migration; previously led web development teams; earlier, Branch Technology
  at a Wall Street firm.
- Section anchor: https://tobyjackson.com/#work

## Projects

- [Gapnop](https://github.com/tobyjackson/gapnop): a minimalist, provider-agnostic
  agent harness in Go — session persistence, declarative skills, MCP
  integration. Actively in progress.
